native_scope: Resident features and weights; full dense floating-point classifier plus threshold; one CPU thread; eager and CUDA graph GPU. Fastest measured baseline defines slowdown; eligible sparse integer models also use a validated sparse native baseline.
deployment_scope: Loopback TLS, four parties share one device. Does not measure independent hosts or WAN.
security: Rep4, at most one corrupt party; two colluding parties can reconstruct secrets.
